units.source_text: 南禅寺同属临济宗，但与相国寺派的金阁寺不同，它是南掸守派的总寺院。

en.t: Nanzenji also belongs to the Rinzai sect, but unlike Kinkakuji of the Shokokuji branch, it is the head temple of the Nansenju branch.

units.source_text: 我们就是在同宗异派的寺庙里。

en.t: We were inside a temple of the same sect but a different branch.

units.source_text: 我们两人却像普通中学生一样，

en.t: Yet the two of us were like ordinary middle school students,

units.source_text: 手拿说明书，一路观赏着色彩鲜艳的壁顶图案，

en.t: holding guide pamphlets in our hands and looking along the way at the vividly colored patterns on the walls and ceiling,

units.source_text: 据说这是出自狩野探幽守信②和土佐法眼德悦③的手笔。

en.t: which were said to be the work of Kano Tanyu Morinobu② and Tosa Hogen Tokuetsu③.
